newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to present Sidor sale contract Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to present Sidor sale contract Wednesday.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will present Congress with the contract for the privatization of Sidor on Wednesday, the Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) said on Tuesday.

Under the contract, 70 percent of the state-owned steel company will be sold to a company or consortium at auction. The remaining 30 percent will be reserved for workers and national companies, the FIV said in a news release.
The winning bidder will have to invest at least $300 million plus another $74 million in a project to remove toxic waste, the FIV said.
Eleven companies from Mexico, Brazil, Japan, South Korea, Argentina and Venezuela have already qualified to bid for Sidor.
The proposed sale is expected to face obstacles in Congress, where many legislators have said they will oppose it.
